frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Local volatility σ_loc(S, t) is the deterministic function such that dS/S = r·dt + σ_loc(S, t)·dW^Q reproduces the entire observed implied-vol surface. Dupire's equation extracts σ_loc² from market call prices: σ_loc² = (∂C/∂T + r·K·∂C/∂K) / ((1/2)·K²·∂²C/∂K²). LSV models supply the joint-path richness exotics need.
